cleaned_text: HDFC Large Cap Fund (Top 100) - Official Scheme Page HDFC Large Cap Fund (HDFC Top 100 Fund) AMC: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited Category: Large Cap Fund - An open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in large cap stocks. Net Asset Value (NAV) & Assets Under Management (AUM) Net Asset Value (NAV): As of June 01, 2026, the Net Asset Value (NAV) for HDFC Large Cap Fund is Rs. 115.80 for the Direct Plan and Rs. 102.40 for the Regular Plan. Assets Under Management (AUM): As of April 30, 2026, the Assets Under Management (AUM) for HDFC Large Cap Fund is Rs. 32,450 Crores. Scheme Suitability & Riskometer This product is suitable for investors who are seeking long-term capital appreciation by investing predominantly in equity and equity-related instruments of large-cap companies. The riskometer for HDFC Large Cap Fund is classified as Very High . Benchmark The benchmark index for HDFC Large Cap Fund is the Nifty 100 TRI (Total Returns Index). Investment Details & Minimum Amounts Minimum SIP Amount: Rs. 100 per month and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. Minimum Initial Investment (Lumpsum): Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. Minimum Additional Purchase: Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. Expense Ratio As of April 30, 2026, the Expense Ratio for HDFC Large Cap Fund is as follows: Direct Plan: 0.75% per annum Regular Plan: 1.40% per annum Exit Load Details The exit load structure for HDFC Large Cap Fund is defined as follows: For redemption/switch-out within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment: 1.00% of the applicable NAV. For redemption/switch-out after 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment: Nil . Last updated from sources: June 01, 2026.
